references.text: Kadesh is also mentioned here as an important place where the Israelites stayed in the wilderness and where the spies returned after exploring the land of Canaan.
The Israelites came to the Wilderness of Sin and camped at Kadesh, which is the starting point for the journey mentioned in verse 22.
This verse repeats the journey from Kadesh to Mount Hor and notes that Aaron died there, which also occurs in the context of Numbers 20.
Mount Hor is mentioned as the place where Aaron died, confirming its significance in Israel's history.
The immediate context describes Aaron's death on Mount Hor, to which the whole congregation came according to verse 22.
Mount Hor is mentioned as a boundary marker for the promised land, showing the geographical importance of the site.
